claim_text: The 2021 consensus states that identification of an NF1 variant in blood alone does not suffice to diagnose NF1; the variant must be confirmed pathogenic by an orthogonal method and classified as constitutional, mosaic, or somatic, and likely pathogenic variants should not count as a criterion.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Modified Delphi expert consensus (74/76 experts); rubric forbids expert_opinion at strength >=4, so capped at 2. Recommendation, not an empirical finding. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Variant classification requirements for NF1 diagnosis.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
